blurb: `by Nobody` sends no credential so that a route's auth seam answers `401`. A public route, guarded by `Visitor`, has no seam that refuses anyone, so the case would test nothing and is refused. Use `by Nobody` on a route guarded by a `Bearer`, `Oidc` or `Signature` actor, and act as `Visitor` on a public one. For the other failure principals, see `bynk.test.expired_needs_bearer_route`.
summary: A case drives `by Nobody` at a route with no Bearer, `Oidc` or Signature actor (alone, or as a member of an actor sum) (e.g. a public `Visitor` route) — there is no auth seam to reject the missing credential.
